newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Tea prices fall at Colombo auction on poor quality.
newsitem.headline: Tea prices fall at Colombo auction on poor quality.

text.p: Tea prices eased at the Colombo auction mainly because of poor quality and the large volume on offer, brokers said on Wednesday.

"Other than a selection of better-made teas, which moved up, all other teas were lower because of poor quality," said a Forbes and Walker broker. "We expect a further price drop for poor teas next week, which might be the deciding sale. Prices might then stabilise and quietly move up."
The anticipated gross sale average for the 4.3 million kg on offer fell to 99 rupees ($1.73) from 99.27 last week, brokers Forbes and Walker said.
